metaTitle: Custom Loose Fit Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom loose fit workwear in bulk for comfort and mobility. Perfect for safety managers and teams. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Loose fit workwear provides the extra room needed for layering and unrestricted movement on the job. Whether you are outfitting a construction crew or warehouse team, this cut accommodates safety gear underneath without binding. Popular items like the Signal Hi-Vis Jacket and Carhartt® Duck Vest are available in relaxed sizing. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered names for a professional look that keeps your team comfortable and safe.
heroAltText: Custom loose fit workwear including hi-vis jackets and vests for bulk orders
